notes.title: Hans | Patch 4
notes.notes:
Hello there rollers!

This update brings some bug fixes, life quality updates and a brand new height-counter.

[Added] Current and Maximum Height Counter.
[Added] New particles for chests.
[Added] Invisible Hans "InvisiHans" skin. (The chest for it is on the second street)
[Added] Keybinding Reset button.
[Changed] Time counter on the top right corner changed from "H-M-S" format to "H-MM-SS" format.
[Fixed] Resolution option bug at the beginning.
[Fixed] The yellow truck's collision at the space.
[Fixed] The dentist chair's collision on the crane.

Well then, I wish you a good roll!

notes.title: HANS | Patch 3
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

With this update, we fixed a minor collision bug and put the image of the first person who finished Hans to the top! He managed to be the one (https://www.twitch.tv/mechayutori)!

So, who's next?

notes.title: HANS | Patch 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This update brings some collision fixes. We've also improved a few areas where players in general were struggling too much.

Happy parkouring! (and falling (:)

notes.title: HANS | Day 1 Patch
notes.notes:
Greetings to everyone!

First of all, thank you very much for your interest in Hans. 
Due to the reports we received on the first day, we have simplified "just the beginning" of the game a bit. We wanted to make it easier for new players to get used to the game. There were also some minor issues with collisions of a few objects, which we solved.

Happy parkour to all of you!
